question: In which year was the Malegam Committee appointed to study issues and concerns of the Micro Finance Sector?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2010**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Malegam Committee was appointed by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to study issues and concerns in the microfinance sector.

• The committee was set up in October 2010.

• The committee was chaired by Y.H. Malegam, a senior member of the Central Board of Directors of the Reserve Bank of India.

• The committee's recommendations aimed at ensuring the growth and development of the microfinance sector while protecting the interests of borrowers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Microfinance:**

• Microfinance refers to the provision of financial services to low-income individuals or groups who are typically excluded from traditional banking services.

• It includes a variety of financial services such as microloans, savings accounts, insurance, and payment services.

• Microfinance aims to empower the poor by providing them with the means to start or expand small businesses, thereby improving their income and living standards.

• **Malegam Committee Recommendations:**

• The committee recommended the creation of a separate category of Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) operating in the microfinance sector, known as NBFC-MFIs (Microfinance Institutions).

• It suggested that the interest rate charged by MFIs should not exceed a certain margin above their cost of funds.

• The committee also recommended that MFIs should not charge more than a specified percentage of the loan amount as processing fees.

• It emphasized the need for greater transparency in the operations of MFIs and suggested measures to prevent over-indebtedness among borrowers.

• **Impact of Malegam Committee:**

• The committee's recommendations were aimed at regulating the microfinance sector to ensure its sustainable growth while protecting the interests of borrowers.

• It helped in bringing in more transparency and accountability in the operations of MFIs.

• The recommendations were instrumental in shaping the regulatory framework for the microfinance sector in India.
